components.name: BaseCard
components.rationale: Uses app theme/effects hooks and shared card-state helpers.

components.name: BaseCardDialog
components.rationale: Uses app theme/i18n hooks and device-editor room/tint controls.

components.name: CardShell
components.rationale: Composes app BaseCard, ModalSurface and size editor with app i18n.

components.name: SheetSurface
components.rationale: Uses app theme context and the app dialog shell.

components.name: SheetSurfaceHeader
components.rationale: Uses app theme context and sheet header token helpers.

components.name: ModalSurface
components.rationale: Uses app theme context and BaseCardDialog.

components.name: FieldBlock
components.rationale: Uses app theme context and typography/spacing helpers; callers own control IDs and validation.

components.name: CardEmptyState
components.rationale: Uses app theme context, card size and entity header/tint helpers.

components.name: DashboardEmptyState
components.rationale: Wraps the shared EmptyStatePanel with app theme and dashboard helpers.

components.name: Button
components.rationale: Reads app theme, accent and primary color; uses app control/focus and appearance-picker helpers. Loading disables the native button; icon-only actions require a label.

components.name: Input
components.rationale: Reads app theme and accent; uses app field/focus helpers. Forwards native input attributes and marks invalid state; callers supply labels and associated help/error IDs.

components.name: Textarea
components.rationale: Reads app theme and accent; uses app field/focus helpers. Forwards native textarea attributes; callers supply labels, validation and associated help/error IDs.

components.name: Checkbox
components.rationale: Wraps Radix Checkbox with app theme, palette types and appearance helpers. Callers supply the label and selection configuration; the component does not compose a field row.

components.name: Radio
components.rationale: Reads app accent color and wraps a native radio input. Callers own group names, labels and selection state.

components.name: Switch
components.rationale: Reads app theme and accent; renders a controlled button with switch semantics. Callers own its accessible name and persistence; a prevented click suppresses onCheckedChange.

components.name: Select
components.rationale: Reads app theme and accent; wraps a native select with app focus helpers. Callers supply options, labels and associated validation text.

components.name: Slider
components.rationale: Uses the app coarse-pointer media-query hook and wraps Radix Slider. Callers supply ariaLabel, controlled value and visual track/thumb styles; live value and commit callbacks have distinct roles.

components.name: Text
components.rationale: Reads app theme and typography tokens. Supports a supplied id for associated text; its narrow props do not forward arbitrary native attributes.

components.name: BodyText
components.rationale: Reads app theme and compact body typography tokens. Its narrow contract accepts as, tone, className and children; it does not forward IDs or other native attributes.

components.name: Heading
components.rationale: Reads app theme and heading typography tokens. Callers choose the semantic h1-h4 level according to the document hierarchy; its narrow props do not forward native attributes.

components.name: Badge
components.rationale: Reads app theme and accent alongside semantic color and typography helpers. Renders a passive span; tone does not provide live-status or interactive behavior.

components.name: Tag
components.rationale: Reads app theme and accent alongside semantic color and typography helpers. Renders a passive span; callers own any surrounding interaction or status announcement.

components.name: Link
components.rationale: Reads app theme and focus helpers. Forwards native anchor attributes and uses target to select external behavior; the declared size prop does not select a different typography token in the current implementation.

components.name: LoadingSpinner
components.rationale: Reads app theme, primary color and i18n for the default message. Full-screen mode uses the app background; callers supply optional message and recovery action.

components.name: IconButton
components.rationale: Composes app Button and inherits its theme, loading and focus dependencies. Requires label and icon; its public variants are narrower than Button variants.

components.name: RoundControlButton
components.rationale: Consumes app ThemeType, card-size geometry and round-control style helpers. Theme is supplied explicitly; callers provide an accessible label or title for icon actions.

components.name: MessageBar
components.rationale: Source marks this inline-feedback contract in progress. It uses app semantic/typography tokens and class utilities without reading theme context; error tone renders alert and other tones render status. Full theme and state acceptance is unverified.

components.name: CardMetricActionLayout
components.rationale: Provider-neutral implementation in @navet/ui accepts metric and action slots with size-based spacing and no app hook dependencies. The exported app import surface is a re-export; the focused test verifies slot anchoring, not complete visual acceptance.

components.name: NavigationWorkspace
components.rationale: Namespace object of workspace parts, not a JSX component. Frame supplies app theme-derived context; compose its named members.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceFrame
components.rationale: Uses app theme hooks to provide workspace surface context. Caller owns responsive layout, navigation state, headings and dimensions.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceGroup
components.rationale: Requires NavigationWorkspace.Frame context for themed grouped surfaces; caller supplies navigation semantics and rows.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceHeader
components.rationale: Requires frame context for its border. Caller supplies heading hierarchy, content and spacing.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceSidebar
components.rationale: Requires frame context for panel and border styling. Caller owns width, responsive presentation and navigation labeling.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceItem
components.rationale: Requires frame context; active and accentColor are required visual inputs. Caller supplies selected-navigation semantics and the actionable child.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceItemButton
components.rationale: Uses app theme focus-ring tokens and a native button. Caller supplies an accessible name, navigation callback and aria-current where applicable.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceItemIcon
components.rationale: Requires frame context and renders an aria-hidden icon span. Caller supplies the icon; the associated button/text must carry its accessible name.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceItemText
components.rationale: Requires frame context and title content; description is optional. Text truncates; review long and translated names in the composed row.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceSeparator
components.rationale: Requires frame context and renders an aria-hidden inset divider. Use inside the grouped row composition shown in the source story.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceBody
components.rationale: Provider-neutral grid wrapper currently exported from the app. Caller owns column definitions, responsive transitions and scroll containment; standalone contract has not been stabilized.

components.name: NavigationWorkspaceContent
components.rationale: Provider-neutral main-region wrapper currently exported from the app. Requires children; caller owns main-landmark placement and an explicit scroll region. Standalone contract has not been stabilized.

components.name: CardDialogHeader
components.rationale: Uses app i18n, provider-session store, entity-room selector and administration service. Requires Radix dialog context for title/description/close; entityId can enable persisted renaming when no onTitleChange callback is supplied.

components.name: CardDialogSection
components.rationale: Uses app theme/typography tokens for visible section label and helper text. Labels are layout content; caller owns control IDs and accessible associations.

components.name: CardDialogTabTrigger
components.rationale: Composes app InteractivePill with explicit active/onClick inputs. Does not provide a tab context or linked tab panels; caller owns selection semantics and keyboard behavior.

components.name: CardDialogChoicePill
components.rationale: Composes app InteractivePill for a controlled active choice. Caller owns selection state, callback and group semantics.

components.name: CardDialogDoneFooter
components.rationale: Composes app Button and Radix Dialog.Close inside the card footer. Requires dialog context and a visible label; dismissing does not perform a save.

components.name: CardDialogBody
components.rationale: Provider-neutral padded layout wrapper exported from the app. It supplies responsive body spacing; caller owns dialog semantics and content.

components.name: CardDialogTabList
components.rationale: Provider-neutral inline layout wrapper exported from the app. Despite its name it does not emit tablist semantics or handle keyboard navigation.

components.name: CardDialogFooter
components.rationale: Provider-neutral action layout wrapper exported from the app with mobile safe-area padding. Caller owns actions, accessible names, callbacks and dialog context.

components.name: CardDialogOverflowMenu
components.rationale: Uses app i18n, Button and Radix menu primitives. Requires theme, sections and onSectionChange; prioritizes room, defers name editing until menu close, and only exposes removal when supplied. Caller owns section state and destructive-action behavior.

components.name: Tabs
components.rationale: App-owned tabs context marked in progress. defaultValue is required even with controlled value; owns generated IDs and selection callbacks. Keyboard navigation is not implemented by this context.

components.name: TabList
components.rationale: Uses app theme surface tokens and responsive overflow metrics. Emits role=tablist; requires composed TabTrigger children and caller labeling. It does not implement arrow-key navigation.

components.name: TabTrigger
components.rationale: Requires Tabs context and app theme/accent tokens. Emits linked tab IDs, aria-selected and active-only tabIndex; click changes selection. Arrow/Home/End navigation is not implemented.

components.name: TabPanel
components.rationale: Requires Tabs context to link its value to the trigger. Inactive panels are hidden, or invisible/inert with preserveLayout; caller supplies content and reviews focus behavior.

components.name: DialogDoneFooter
components.rationale: Composes app Button and Radix Dialog.Close with a required label. Requires dialog context; closure does not save settings.

components.name: CustomDialogDoneButton
components.rationale: Composes the small app Button within Radix Dialog.Close. Requires dialog context and a visible label; caller owns settings persistence.

components.name: DialogFooter
components.rationale: Provider-neutral footer layout currently exported from the app. Supplies action alignment and height rules; caller supplies buttons and behavior.

components.name: DialogDoneButton
components.rationale: App-owned Radix close wrapper with default white text classes. Requires dialog context and label; caller must inspect or supply theme-appropriate className/style in light compositions.

components.name: SettingsDialogDoneButton
components.rationale: App-owned close wrapper requiring caller-supplied textPrimary, subtleBg and hoverBg surface classes. Requires dialog context and label; dismissal does not perform persistence.
